business_summary: Alphabet Inc. designs and deploys its own Tensor Processing Unit AI accelerators, builds and operates hyperscale Google Cloud data-center campuses, researches and serves the Gemini family of frontier models, and ships Gemini Enterprise agent tooling. It sits on four links: ai-accelerators, hyperscale-datacenters, frontier-models and ai-applications, alongside its core advertising and search business, which this chain does not cover.

exposure_summary.narrative: Each placement is backed by a dated source (an operator census for the data-center role, AI-chip research for the TPU role, and Alphabet's own model and product announcements for Gemini and Gemini Enterprise), but all four sit inside a company whose largest revenue line is advertising; none of these four AI-infrastructure roles is disclosed as a standalone segment with its own revenue.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: No revenue-exposure percentage for this chain's links is disclosed in the sources on file: the mapping role_evidence for ALPHABET carries qualitative product/operator claims, not a segment revenue split, and no data/edgar/docs/GOOGL.json filing is on disk this run to check for one.

latest_fy.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/GOOGL.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
latest_fy.basis: Revenues for fiscal year ended 2024-12-31 as reported to SEC XBRL.

revenue_cagr_3y.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/GOOGL.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (350018000000 / 257637000000) ** (1/3) - 1 from the companyfacts Revenues series, fiscal year ended 2021-12-31 to fiscal year ended 2024-12-31.

operating_margin.basis: data/market/GOOGL.json fundamentals.revenue_fy (latest 2024-12-31) and operating_income_fy (latest 2025-12-31) do not share a common latest fiscal-year date, so operating margin cannot be computed without mixing periods.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/GOOGL.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities 164713000000 divided by net income 132170000000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts.

net_debt_to_ebitda.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/GOOGL.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 42254000000 (total debt 98165000000 as of 2026-06-30 less cash 55911000000 as of 2026-06-30) divided by an EBITDA proxy 150175000000 (operating income 129039000000 plus depreciation 21136000000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31).

piotroski.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/GOOGL.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 7 (state STRONG) computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/GOOGL.json quality.piotroski.

beneish_state.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/GOOGL.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score -2.587, earnings-manipulation state CLEAN, computed over SEC companyfacts statements in data/market/GOOGL.json quality.beneish. A more negative M-score is the non-manipulator reading.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 4189579919999.9995 = SEC companyfacts diluted share count 12088000000 (as of 2025-12-31) multiplied by the close 346.59 of 2026-08-28 from the repo's own market plane (data/market/GOOGL.json), not an issuer document.

price_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/GOOGL.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts revenue
price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 4189579919999.9995 divided by fiscal year 2024-12-31 revenue 350018000000.

price_to_earnings.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/GOOGL.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts net income
price_to_earnings.basis: Market capitalization 4189579919999.9995 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 GAAP net income 132170000000.

ev_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/GOOGL.json quality.derived.enterprise_value over SEC companyfacts revenue
ev_to_sales.basis: Enterprise value 4231833919999.9995 divided by fiscal year 2024-12-31 revenue 350018000000.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 4231833919999.9995 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 73266000000.0, solved by bisection on FCF CAGR at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth. The discount rate and terminal growth are assumed, so the solve is an assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon ({'5': 0.3594, '7': 0.2642, '10': 0.1974}). It measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a statement about price, and inherits the same assumed discount rate and terminal growth.

crowdedness_caveats: ai-accelerators and frontier-models are both chain-heat OVER_CROWDED, and hyperscale-datacenters is CROWDED; Alphabet is one of the most heavily covered companies in public markets on any of these four theses.

margins.operating_margin is NULL here: fundamentals.revenue_fy's latest entry (fiscal 2024-12-31) does not match operating_income_fy's latest entry (fiscal 2025-12-31) in the market store, a one-fiscal-year gap in the revenue series specifically.

catalysts.claim: ABI Research's 2025 operator census ranks Google Cloud as a tier-one hyperscale data-center operator, and Google's own Gemini 3.7 Flash announcement describes it as the current high-capability model for coding and agent workloads.
Revenue grew from $307.4B to $350.0B in the fundamentals series (computed three-year CAGR of 10.8%), with operating cash flow covering 1.25x net income.
catalysts.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/GOOGL.json

risks.claim: The reverse DCF solved on current enterprise value implies a 35.9% five-year free-cash-flow CAGR against a base that already funds massive capital expenditure across four separate AI-infrastructure roles simultaneously.

None of the four placements is a standalone reporting segment; Alphabet's advertising business, not covered by this chain at all, remains the dominant driver of consolidated results, which dilutes any un-crowded AI-infrastructure thesis specific to this name.
risks.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/GOOGL.json and data/chains/ai-infrastructure.json

disposition.basis: Newly profiled to close the hyperscale-datacenters link's zero-coverage gap (and add depth on three others already thin). Retained at O2: broad, well-evidenced exposure across four crowded links inside a business whose economics are still dominated by advertising, which the profile records as a caveat rather than resolving it.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from SEC companyfacts, with the derivation named in its basis. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL is a field looked for and not found or unusable without mixing reporting periods, never estimated.

notes: Profiles are medium-depth reusable research. This file carries no final verdict, no entry zone and no red team; those belong to the deep-dive stage.
Data tier (T1/T2/T3) describes data availability. Opportunity tier (O1/O2/O3) describes research priority. Neither implies the other.
